# Local Three.js assets

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

`three/` contains the unmodified official npm distribution for offline core and addon imports. Keep this directory with the project.

- Package: `three@0.169.0`, matching the original CDN version.
- Source: [npm tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.169.0.tgz).
- Downloaded: 2026-11-03.
- Integrity: checked against the npm metadata SHA-512 value below.
- Main license: MIT; original notice in `three/LICENSE`. Preserve the additional licenses and inline notices of bundled fonts, example libraries and binaries, too.
- No upstream files were modified. The import map is in `../index.html`.

```text
sha512-Ed906MA3dR4TS5riErd4QBsRGPcx+HBDX2O5yYE5GqJeFQTPU+M56Va/f/Oph9X7uZo3W3o4l2ZhBZ6f6qUv0w==
```

When updating, replace the complete package consistently, preserve licenses and verify core/addon imports. Do not mix versions.
